# Blocks

30 ready-made sections, each a single file in `src/blocks`. Browse them live at `/ui/blocks`, open the Code tab, and copy the file into your page. Sample numbers come from `src/blocks/_data.ts`; replace them with your queries.

<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/gen-components.mjs from src/blocks/registry.ts. Don't edit by hand. -->

## Stats

| Block | What it shows | File |
|---|---|---|
| **Stat row** | Four KPI cards with change and a 7-day sparkline. | `src/blocks/stats/StatRow.tsx` |
| **Hero metric** | The one number a page leads with, its change and a 30-day chart. | `src/blocks/stats/StatHero.tsx` |
| **Stat strip** | Five compact numbers in one card, for above a table. | `src/blocks/stats/StatStrip.tsx` |
| **Goal progress** | Targets with progress that turns amber when behind pace. | `src/blocks/stats/GoalProgress.tsx` |
| **Health gauges** | Three gauges with good, warning and critical bands. | `src/blocks/stats/HealthGauges.tsx` |
